elevenlabsPrompt:
[intrigued] Can't reach the top of your phone without dropping it?

[confident] Here's the fix. Turn on one-handed mode.

[friendly] Open Settings, System, then Gestures. Tap One-handed mode and switch it on. Swipe down at the bottom edge.

[delighted] The whole top half drops right under your thumb.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
